source_method: Approved Atera tenant; source-access end date; required retention periods
destination_method: Approved Syncro tenant and migration owner
transfer_scope: Customers; contacts; tickets; ticket comments; endpoints; invoices; configurations; history
required_source_evidence: Signed scope; source-access deadline; contract and retention requirements
validation_test: Review every row in this worksheet before extracting data
pass_criteria: Every required record and workflow has an owner; destination path; retention decision; and acceptance test
known_gap_or_risk: An unlisted entity can disappear when source access ends

source_method: Create or retrieve the current Atera API token through the documented admin workflow
destination_method: Enter the token only in Syncro's Atera Importer; never paste it into this worksheet
transfer_scope: Importer-authorized source access
required_source_evidence: Token owner; creation time; approved rate limit; expiry or rotation plan
validation_test: Confirm the importer can authenticate without exposing the token in notes or evidence
pass_criteria: Authentication succeeds; the secret is stored only in an approved secret location
known_gap_or_risk: Leaked or overprivileged API credentials

source_method: Export required Atera reports and API responses by entity; keep originals unchanged
destination_method: Use working copies for mapping or transformation
transfer_scope: Source archive; not an importer input unless Syncro documents it
required_source_evidence: Capture timestamp; filters; page counts; row counts; file hash; storage owner
validation_test: Reopen each original and compare recorded counts and hashes
pass_criteria: Original source evidence is readable; immutable; dated; and owned
known_gap_or_risk: A later transformation can overwrite the only source copy

source_method: Atera customer records or the dedicated importer API connection
destination_method: Syncro Atera Importer
transfer_scope: Name; phone; address; notes or domain as documented by Syncro
required_source_evidence: Source customer ID; name; domain; contact count; active status
validation_test: Compare source and destination counts; names; domains; phone and address samples
pass_criteria: Every in-scope customer has one intended destination organization and explained exceptions
known_gap_or_risk: Duplicate or near-match customer names can create incorrect mappings

source_method: Atera contacts API or the dedicated importer API connection
destination_method: Syncro Atera Importer
transfer_scope: Name; email; title; phone as documented by Syncro
required_source_evidence: Source contact ID; parent customer ID; email; phone; active status
validation_test: Sample customers with multiple contacts and compare parent relationships
pass_criteria: Every in-scope contact is attached to the intended customer; duplicates are explained
known_gap_or_risk: Contacts without stable parent mapping can land under the wrong customer

source_method: Inventory every Atera ticket status and count tickets by status
destination_method: Create corresponding Syncro ticket statuses before import
transfer_scope: Status labels and operational meaning; not automatic status equivalence
required_source_evidence: Source status list; ticket count by status; intended destination status; approval
validation_test: Import a representative ticket for every status and inspect the destination value
pass_criteria: No imported ticket has a blank or unintended status; exception treatment is documented
known_gap_or_risk: Syncro documents that imported Atera tickets may appear blank until statuses are added

source_method: Atera tickets API through the dedicated importer
destination_method: Syncro Atera Importer
transfer_scope: ID; title; status; type; contact; priority; resolved date as documented by Syncro
required_source_evidence: Source ticket ID; customer; contact; status; priority; created and resolved dates
validation_test: Compare a sample across open; closed; merged; pending; old and recent tickets
pass_criteria: Required ticket fields and parent relationships match; count differences are explained
known_gap_or_risk: Imported Atera tickets do not arrive under Syncro's Resolved status

source_method: Atera ticket comments through the dedicated importer
destination_method: Syncro Atera Importer
transfer_scope: Comment body as documented by Syncro
required_source_evidence: Ticket ID; comment count; author if available; timestamp; attachment indicator
validation_test: Compare comment order and count on representative multi-comment tickets
pass_criteria: Required comment bodies are present under the correct tickets; missing metadata is documented
known_gap_or_risk: Attachments and full author or timestamp fidelity may require separate preservation

source_method: Export or retain Atera invoice history using the approved source method
destination_method: Archive outside the Atera Importer; rebuild only through a separately approved accounting workflow
transfer_scope: Not imported by Syncro's Atera Importer
required_source_evidence: Invoice count; period; customer; total; export format; storage owner
validation_test: Open representative historical invoices and reconcile totals to the source report
pass_criteria: Required invoice history is retained and readable after source access ends
known_gap_or_risk: Syncro explicitly documents that Atera invoices are not imported

source_method: Download required Atera attachments individually where applicable
destination_method: Retain in the approved archive and link to destination records only if authorized
transfer_scope: Not included in Atera bulk exports according to Atera's export FAQ
required_source_evidence: Parent record ID; filename; size; hash; sensitivity; retention owner
validation_test: Open samples; verify hashes; confirm access controls and parent-record mapping
pass_criteria: Every required attachment is readable; protected; and traceable to its source record
known_gap_or_risk: Bulk record transfer can appear complete while attachments are missing

source_method: Export Atera agents and devices with customer assignment and status; record source IDs
destination_method: Use Syncro's documented customer-preparation and agent-deployment workflow
transfer_scope: Inventory evidence is preserved; endpoint management moves through new-agent deployment
required_source_evidence: Hostname; serial or durable identifier; OS; customer; source agent ID; last seen; criticality
validation_test: Reconcile source inventory to destination assets using more than hostname alone
pass_criteria: Every in-scope endpoint is accepted once or has an owned exception
known_gap_or_risk: Cloned names; stale devices; and offline endpoints can distort deployment percentages

source_method: Validate Atera customer names and source-to-destination mapping
destination_method: Run Syncro's Prepare Customer Database step before obtaining the deployment script
transfer_scope: Customer mapping used by Syncro's Atera deployment script
required_source_evidence: Source customer ID; destination organization ID; approved mapping; duplicate decision
validation_test: Pilot one endpoint from customers with similar names and inspect destination placement
pass_criteria: Every pilot endpoint lands under the intended destination organization
known_gap_or_risk: An incorrect customer match can create a cross-tenant asset placement

source_method: Run the Syncro-provided deployment script through an authorized Atera automation on representative noncritical endpoints
destination_method: Syncro agent enrollment
transfer_scope: New endpoint enrollment; not historical device-state transfer
required_source_evidence: Approved script revision; target cohort; change window; rollback; source agent state
validation_test: Verify check-in; organization; device identity; policy; remote access; monitoring; uninstall path
pass_criteria: All pilot acceptance tests pass without disrupting source coverage
known_gap_or_risk: Mass deployment before mapping and rollback proof can create broad monitoring gaps

source_method: Document Atera monitoring profiles; thresholds; assignments; exceptions and alert routes
destination_method: Rebuild and test approved destination monitoring in Syncro
transfer_scope: Manual rebuild; Atera says monitoring profiles are not exportable
required_source_evidence: Profile owner; rule; threshold; persistence; assignment; exception; alert destination
validation_test: Generate bounded test conditions and follow alerts through technician receipt
pass_criteria: Required monitoring and routing behave as approved on pilot endpoints
known_gap_or_risk: Agent check-in does not prove monitoring equivalence

source_method: Inventory Atera scripts; schedules; permissions; secrets; dependencies; revisions and owners
destination_method: Review; rewrite or retire each workflow in Syncro; test as a new implementation
transfer_scope: Manual rebuild; not an assumed importer transfer
required_source_evidence: Script digest; purpose; privilege; dependencies; schedule; target; failure and rollback behavior
validation_test: Run safe read-only tests first; then verify bounded success and failure evidence
pass_criteria: Every required automation is approved; tested; owned; and recoverable
known_gap_or_risk: Copying old code without dependency and privilege review can reproduce hidden risk

source_method: Document Atera approval rules; rings; schedules; reboot behavior; exclusions and reporting
destination_method: Rebuild and test destination patch policies in Syncro
transfer_scope: Manual rebuild and observed validation
required_source_evidence: Policy owner; device scope; approvals; deferrals; reboot rules; exception list; report baseline
validation_test: Complete a representative patch cycle before retiring source control
pass_criteria: Required devices show the intended policy; outcomes; reboots; failures and exceptions
known_gap_or_risk: Two active patch authorities can issue conflicting actions

source_method: Export required Atera alerts through the API and preserve reports needed for service or audit history
destination_method: Retain read-only history outside the importer; start new destination history after acceptance
transfer_scope: Atera API export or source archive; not documented as an Atera Importer entity
required_source_evidence: Alert ID; device; customer; state; severity; created and resolved times; owner
validation_test: Reconcile a representative period and confirm retained search or retrieval
pass_criteria: Required history remains available with documented gaps and retention dates
known_gap_or_risk: A successful customer and ticket import does not preserve all RMM history

source_method: Record the Atera plan limit; export page size; page count; retry and throttle behavior
destination_method: Use the approved rate-limit value in Syncro's importer and preserve importer results
transfer_scope: Complete extraction and import without silent truncation
required_source_evidence: Expected entity counts; page tokens; start and finish times; retries; failure records
validation_test: Compare expected counts to completed pages and destination results before rerunning
pass_criteria: Every page and importer stage has a terminal result or owned exception
known_gap_or_risk: Repeating an uncertain import can create duplicates

source_method: Inventory required technician roles; customer scopes; MFA or SSO; approval boundaries and audit needs
destination_method: Create least-privilege Syncro roles and test ordinary technician tasks
transfer_scope: Manual security configuration
required_source_evidence: Role matrix; named testers; prohibited actions; MFA evidence; audit expectations
validation_test: Test ticket work; script approval; remote access; reporting and audit as ordinary roles
pass_criteria: Required work succeeds without global-admin access; prohibited work remains blocked
known_gap_or_risk: Testing only as an administrator hides role and audit failures

source_method: Capture source monitoring-to-ticket baselines for representative customers and critical devices
destination_method: Test destination monitoring; ticket creation; assignment; notification; escalation and closure
transfer_scope: Observed workflow acceptance
required_source_evidence: Test device; alert condition; expected customer; priority; queue; assignee; notification; SLA
validation_test: Generate a controlled alert and follow it from endpoint through technician resolution
pass_criteria: The correct destination ticket and notifications appear with complete context and audit evidence
known_gap_or_risk: A healthy dashboard can coexist with a broken ticket route

source_method: Keep Atera available during the bounded pilot where contracts and policy permit
destination_method: Assign one authoritative platform per function and wave
transfer_scope: Controlled overlap only
required_source_evidence: Authority for monitoring; patching; scripts; reboot; remote access; tickets; start and end dates
validation_test: Review active schedules and run logs before each wave
pass_criteria: No duplicate or conflicting action occurs; overlap has a named owner and end date
known_gap_or_risk: Unbounded overlap can create duplicate tickets; scripts; patches or reboots

source_method: Export final Atera endpoint inventory with last-seen timestamps
destination_method: Export Syncro destination inventory after each wave
transfer_scope: One-to-one accepted endpoint state plus exceptions
required_source_evidence: Source ID; durable device ID; destination ID; check-in; policy; customer; final source-agent state
validation_test: Reconcile every in-scope source endpoint against the destination and exception register
pass_criteria: Every endpoint is accepted exactly once or has an owner; impact; mitigation and due date
known_gap_or_risk: Percent-complete dashboards can hide missing or duplicated endpoints

source_method: Inventory Atera API tokens; webhooks; email routes; integrations; technicians and service accounts
destination_method: Revoke obsolete source credentials only after acceptance and retain audit proof
transfer_scope: Manual security closeout
required_source_evidence: Credential owner; dependency; last use; revocation time; replacement; audit event
validation_test: Confirm destination workflows remain healthy after staged source revocation
pass_criteria: Every obsolete credential and integration is revoked or has a time-bounded exception
known_gap_or_risk: Premature revocation can break rollback; delayed revocation preserves unnecessary access

source_method: Preserve required Atera exports; evidence; invoices; attachments and residual exceptions
destination_method: Approve Syncro operational acceptance; remove the source agent and end access under the contract plan
transfer_scope: Formal migration closeout
required_source_evidence: Final counts; open exceptions; retained-history location; customer notice; cancellation and deletion dates
validation_test: Verify monitoring; patching; automation; remote access; ticketing; audit and retrieval after source removal
pass_criteria: Named operational and business owners accept the final state; every exception remains owned
known_gap_or_risk: Cancellation before evidence and retention checks can make gaps irreversible
